== Events ==
* [[The Queen sentences the gardeners to execution, but Alice rescues them in a flower-pot]]
* [[The Queen's grand procession arrives at the garden; Alice chooses not to bow]]
* [[The Cheshire Cat vanishes and reappears, confirming that the baby indeed became a pig before disappearing gradually]]
* [[Alice enters the Rabbit's house and finds the requested items, but discovers an unlabeled bottle near the looking glass]]
* [[The Mock Turtle becomes intrigued when Alice claims the words she recited to the Caterpillar came out different than she remembered]]
* [[After a frustrating exchange with the indifferent Caterpillar, Alice agrees to wait when he promises something important to say]]
* [[Alice complains about being three inches tall, but the Caterpillar (who is exactly three inches high himself) declares it a good height and says she will adjust in time]]
* [[The Rabbit and his companions attempt to extract Alice; she kicks a creature named Bill down the chimney]]
* [[Alice and the wet animals gather on the bank; the Mouse proposes reciting history to dry them off]]
* [[The Mouse begins telling his personal history but becomes angry when Alice misunderstands his 'long tail' and storms away]]
* [[Left alone, Alice grieves over mentioning Dinah and waits sadly, hoping the Mouse will return]]
